coordinate_system: 648-class school frontal photograph at its original 638 × 431. The northern two columns outside the crop are transferred from school aerial 10 using the common exposed facade. Values are reference pixels, Z increases upwards after conversion.
limitations: The front steps and guard bases are directly visible. The northernmost ground arch is obscured in the high-angle image, and is represented by a shallow blind arch only. The east return, round south tower and clerestory remain outside this frontage study.
